settings.content: Loose stones to choose from, and the guidance to choose one with confidence

settings.heading: Choose the Stone First, Then Design Around It
settings.body:
Most of our bespoke work begins with a stone rather than with a ring. Once you know what is at the centre, everything else follows: the setting that protects it, the metal that flatters it, the width that carries it.

We hold a very large loose inventory across natural and lab-grown diamonds, fancy coloured diamonds, and coloured gemstones including sapphire, ruby, emerald, aquamarine and tanzanite. Any of them can be set into a design from our collections or into something drawn from scratch.

If you would rather browse finished pieces and worry about stones later, that works too.
